# lettermint_routes (Data Source)

List routes for one Lettermint project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lettermint_routes" "project" {
  project_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
  route_type = "transactional"
  sort       = ["name"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `page_size` (Number) Results requested per API page. The API default is 30.
- `route_type` (String)
- `search` (String)
- `sort` (List of String) Sort values in API order. The API default is -created_at.

### Read-Only

- `routes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `route_type` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `suppressed_recipients_count` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `webhooks_count` (Number)
